equivalence_esa_iwi.claim: esa and iwi egungun are two names for one egungun-cult chant form.

sources.work: Akinbo, Samuel, Alaga and Akingbade (2022), Frontiers in Communication 7:1029400
Fámúlẹ̀, Èdè Àyàn, Yoruba Studies Review
sources.reported_wording: Èṣà/iwì egúngún are praise songs or chants of egúngún
sources.licence: CC BY-NC 4.0 on the article page

caveats: Spelling varies (ẹ̀sà, èsà, Èṣà; iwì, Ìwí). Adeduntan's footnote 1 separately warns that iwì must not be confused with ewì, the general word for Yoruba poetry (reported by the tool; the footnote text itself was not retrieved).
Fámúlẹ̀'s footnote also says the same chants are called oríkì when they praise one family or lineage, so an oríkì is not automatically an iwì text.
Equivalence lets a passage that its own source labels esa or iwi egungun be taught under the scheme's iwi egungun label. It does not make a modern composed poem an inherited chant.

candidates.work: Akinbo et al. (2022), Example (3), Section 4.1, p. 3
candidates.finding: The four-line poem is an original oríkì written for the study by the third author and memorised by one student, who recited the same poem in speech mode, in ìjálá and in esa. It is not an esa-specific text and not an inherited chant.
candidates.reason: A study-composed oríkì used for three vocal modes cannot stand for an iwi chant, even if labelled modern.

modern_equivalent_assessment.principle: A clearly labelled, source-backed modern equivalent is not disqualified for being modern. It is assessed against the objective (text study of iwi egungun) and never labelled an inherited traditional chant.
modern_equivalent_assessment.rights: CC BY, copyright held by the article authors; the poem was composed by a co-author, so its origin is documented.
modern_equivalent_assessment.objective_fit: Fails. The poem is a general praise poem (oríkì) that one performer recited in speech mode, in ìjálá and in esa. Its words carry nothing specific to esa/iwi, so studying them would teach a praise poem, not the iwi genre.
modern_equivalent_assessment.could_it_work_if_relabelled: Only as "a modern praise poem chanted in esa mode for a study", which would not meet the objective and would change what the lesson claims. Not done.
